entries.en: Added Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`), now the default Sonnet model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $2/$10 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
entries.zh: 添加了 Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`)，现在是 Anthropic API 上的默认 Sonnet 模型 — 1M 上下文，每个 Mtok $2/$10，其中 $0.20/Mtok 缓存读取

entries.en: Added a "Yes, but ask again next time" answer to auto mode's prompt before a read outside the working directories, so you can allow that one read and still be asked about later ones
entries.zh: 在读取工作目录之外的内容之前，在自动模式的提示中添加了“是，但下次再询问”答案，这样您就可以允许该读取，但仍会被询问稍后的内容

entries.en: Added dollar amounts to the Claude apps gateway spend limit in `/usage` and the status line (for example "$271.40 / $500.00 spent this month") when the gateway runs this version or later; the status line's `rate_limits.spend_limit` also gains `used_usd`, `limit_usd` and `period`
entries.zh: 当网关运行此版本或更高版本时，在`/usage`和状态行中为 Claude 应用程序网关支出限制添加了美元金额（例如“本月支出 271.40 美元/500.00 美元”）；状态行的 `rate_limits.spend_limit` 也获得 `used_usd`、`limit_usd` 和 `period`

entries.en: Added `effortSlider:decreaseEffort`, `increaseEffort` and `toggleUltracode` keybinding actions, so the `/effort` slider's arrow and Tab keys can be rebound in `keybindings.json`
entries.zh: 添加了 `effortSlider:decreaseEffort`、`increaseEffort` 和 `toggleUltracode` 键绑定操作，因此 `/effort` 滑块的箭头和 Tab 键可以在 `keybindings.json` 中反弹

entries.en: Added `/rate-limit-options` to `/help` and the command menu for claude.ai subscribers, so the usage-limit notices that mention it point to a command you can find
entries.zh: 将`/rate-limit-options`添加到`/help`和 claude.ai 订阅者的命令菜单中，因此提及它的使用限制通知指向您可以找到的命令

entries.en: Added `/mcp reconnect all` in the interactive terminal to retry every MCP server that failed to connect or needs authentication at once
entries.zh: 在交互式终端中添加了`/mcp reconnect all`，以立即重试每个连接失败或需要身份验证的 MCP 服务器

entries.en: Added Claude apps gateway startup warnings when a managed policy's `availableModels` is empty, or leaves out the model Claude Code starts on without setting `model` or `enforceAvailableModels`
entries.zh: 当托管策略的`availableModels`为空或遗漏模型时，添加了克劳德应用程序网关启动警告，克劳德代码在未设置`model`或`enforceAvailableModels`的情况下启动

entries.en: Added `auth: { google: {} }` for Claude apps gateway `telemetry.forward_to` destinations, so telemetry can be exported straight to Google Cloud's OTLP endpoint using the gateway's Google Cloud credentials
entries.zh: 为 Claude 应用网关`telemetry.forward_to`目的地添加了`auth: { google: {} }`，因此可以使用网关的 Google Cloud 凭据将遥测数据直接导出到 Google Cloud 的 OTLP 端点

entries.en: Added certificate client authentication (`private_key_jwt`) between the Claude apps gateway and its identity provider, for identity providers that issue certificate credentials instead of client secrets
entries.zh: 在 Claude 应用程序网关与其身份提供商之间添加了证书客户端身份验证 (`private_key_jwt`)，适用于颁发证书凭据而不是客户端密钥的身份提供商

entries.en: [VSCode] Added an optional time above each prompt and response, with a date line where the day changes (Claude Code: Show Message Timestamps setting, off by default)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 每条提示和回复上方可选显示时间，日期变化时会显示日期行（设置为 Claude Code: Show Message Timestamps，默认关闭）

entries.en: [VSCode] Added plugin load errors and notes to the Manage plugins rows, with a popup to disable, uninstall or copy the error
entries.zh: [VSCode] 管理插件的每一行显示插件加载错误和说明，并提供弹窗以禁用、卸载或复制错误信息

entries.en: [VSCode] Added an Ultracode on/off switch under the Effort slider, replacing the slider's Ultracode stop; the model pill shows "· Ultracode" at any effort level
entries.zh: [VSCode] Effort 滑块下方新增 Ultracode 开关，取代滑块原有的 Ultracode 档位；在任何 effort 级别下，模型标签都会显示「· Ultracode」

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added model family choices such as "Opus (latest)" for a thread, a channel default or your DM, so the choice follows the newest model in that family
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 话题、频道默认设置或你的私信中新增模型系列选项（如「Opus (latest)」），选择后会自动跟随该系列的最新模型

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added the spend that counts toward your organization-wide limit to the analytics spend projection chart, with how much of the limit is used
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 花费分析的预计支出图表中，新增计入组织总限额的花费，并显示已使用的限额比例

entries.en: Improved the usage-limit wait: the limit's state and the countdown with the usage-credits option now show as one block under the prompt, and limit messages no longer repeat the countdown
entries.zh: 改进用量限额等待提示：限额状态和带用量积分选项的倒计时合并显示为提示框下方的一个区块，限额消息不再重复显示倒计时

entries.en: Improved the "No such tool available" error for Claude in Chrome tools called without their prefix: it now names the tool to call
entries.zh: 改进 Claude in Chrome 工具在缺少前缀时的「No such tool available」报错：现在会指出应调用的工具名

entries.en: Improved Monitor event rows to show what each event printed instead of repeating the description, and stopped repeating an unchanged "Waiting for N … to finish" line after every event
entries.zh: 改进 Monitor 事件行：显示每个事件实际输出的内容，而不是重复描述；未变化的“Waiting for N … to finish”行不再在每个事件后重复出现

entries.en: Improved Workflow tool sandbox hardening for errors thrown by async script hooks
entries.zh: 改进 Workflow 工具的沙箱加固：针对异步脚本钩子抛出的错误

entries.en: Improved startup time and memory use by building only the parts of the settings schema that your settings files actually use
entries.zh: 改进启动时间和内存占用：只构建你的设置文件实际用到的那部分设置 schema

entries.en: Improved `/claude-api`: `hillclimb` no longer spends rounds on prompt rewordings too small for the eval to measure, and an extra page you ask for beside `report.html` is built as one local file that loads nothing from the network
entries.zh: 改进 `/claude-api`：`hillclimb` 不再把轮次浪费在评测无法衡量的微小措辞改动上；你要求的、与 `report.html` 并列的额外页面，会构建为一个不从网络加载任何内容的本地文件

entries.en: Improved lists such as `/tasks`, `/copy` and `/hooks`: the details after each name now line up in one column when they fit, and otherwise sit at the right edge
entries.zh: 改进 `/tasks`、`/copy`、`/hooks` 等列表：名称后的详情在空间足够时对齐成一列，否则靠右边缘显示

entries.en: Improved `claude plugin marketplace add` to say when it replaces a marketplace already added under the same name from a different source, and how to undo it
entries.zh: 改进 `claude plugin marketplace add`：若替换了同名但来源不同的已添加市场，会说明替换情况以及如何撤销

entries.en: Improved the startup refusal when managed settings require a sign-in (`forceLoginMethod` or `forceLoginOrgUUID`) and an API key, token or `apiKeyHelper` is configured: it now names the credential in use, where it is set, and how to remove it
entries.zh: 改进启动拒绝提示：当托管设置要求登录（`forceLoginMethod` 或 `forceLoginOrgUUID`），而又配置了 API 密钥、令牌或 `apiKeyHelper` 时，会写明正在使用的凭证、它在哪里设置，以及如何删除

entries.en: Improved auto-memory loading: invisible characters and tags that imitate Claude Code's own markup are neutralized in `MEMORY.md` and recalled memory notes before they reach Claude
entries.zh: 改进自动记忆加载：`MEMORY.md` 和被调用的记忆笔记中，模仿 Claude Code 自身标记的不可见字符和标签，在送给 Claude 前会被中和

entries.en: Improved `claude remote-control`: in a folder you haven't trusted yet, it now asks for workspace trust on the terminal instead of exiting
entries.zh: 改进 `claude remote-control`：在尚未信任的文件夹中，会在终端上询问工作区信任，而不是直接退出

entries.en: Improved artifact pages: Claude writes its design plan into the page instead of the reply, and uses the name you already gave something as the page title
entries.zh: 改进 artifact 页面：Claude 把设计方案写进页面而不是回复里；页面标题沿用你已经给它起的名字

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool so that when Claude is given a claude.ai chat or project link, an artifact from a chat, or an artifact id on its own, it asks for the right link or the content instead of stopping
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具：当 Claude 拿到 claude.ai 聊天或项目链接、聊天中的 Artifact，或单独一个 Artifact ID 时，会请你提供正确的链接或内容，而不是直接停止

entries.en: Changed interactive terminal and VS Code sessions to start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured, on every plan and provider; `permissions.defaultMode` still overrides it
entries.zh: 将交互式终端和 VS Code 会话更改为在每个计划和提供程序上未配置权限模式时以自动模式启动； `permissions.defaultMode` 仍然会覆盖它

entries.en: Changed Ultracode into its own toggle in `/effort` (Tab, or `/effort ultracode [on|off]`): it no longer forces xhigh effort and stays on at any effort level
entries.zh: 将 Ultracode 更改为`/effort`中自己的切换（Tab 或`/effort ultracode [on|off]`）：它不再强制 xhigh 努力并保持在任何努力级别

entries.en: Changed retries after a dropped connection mid-response to share one budget with the rest of the request's retries, so a failing request gives up sooner
entries.zh: 更改了响应中途连接断开后的重试，以便与请求的其余重试共享一个预算，因此失败的请求会更快放弃

entries.en: Changed the notice shown when a Sonnet model's safeguards flag a message to explain why it happened and to offer editing and retrying
entries.zh: 更改了 Sonnet 模型的防护措施标记消息以解释其发生原因并提供编辑和重试时显示的通知

entries.en: Changed safety-related model switches in sessions that pin an Opus model with `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` or `modelOverrides`: on the Anthropic API, the API now picks the model to switch to for each kind of flag, not the pinned model
entries.zh: 更改了使用`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`或`modelOverrides`固定 Opus 模型的会话中的安全相关模型开关：在 Anthropic API 上，API 现在为每种标志选择要切换到的模型，而不是固定模型

entries.en: Changed the non-interactive first turn to still wait up to 2s for connecting MCP servers named by `--allowedTools` or an `mcp_tool` hook, even when `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` is `0`
entries.zh: 更改了非交互式第一轮，即使当`CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS`为`0`时，仍等待最多 2 秒来连接由`--allowedTools`或`mcp_tool`挂钩命名的 MCP 服务器

entries.en: Changed `/recap` to decline with a short notice when it arrives relayed from a chat thread (your own included) or from a routine or webhook; typed in the terminal, the Claude apps, Remote Control, `-p` or an SDK host, it runs as before
entries.zh: 将`/recap`更改为当从聊天线程（包括您自己的）或例程或 Webhook 中继到达时立即拒绝；在终端、Claude 应用程序、远程控制、`-p` 或 SDK 主机中输入，它会像以前一样运行

entries.en: Changed `/artifacts` to show its filter tabs beside the title with one-word labels (All, Mine, Shared), using the same tab bar as `/config` and `/plugin`
entries.zh: 更改了`/artifacts`，以在标题旁边显示带有单字标签（“全部”、“我的”、“共享”）的过滤器选项卡，使用与`/config`和`/plugin`相同的选项卡栏

entries.en: Changed artifact publishing to refuse a file on a network share (a `\\host\share` path or a `/net` automount) unless it is on a mapped network drive added with `--add-dir`
entries.zh: 更改了工件发布以拒绝网络共享（`\\host\share`路径或`/net`自动挂载）上的文件，除非该文件位于使用`--add-dir`添加的映射网络驱动器上

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` in the `claudeCode.environmentVariables` setting to apply only when it is an absolute path, and passed it to terminals that continue the chat
entries.zh: [VSCode] `claudeCode.environmentVariables` 设置中的 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 仅在为绝对路径时生效，并会传递给用于继续聊天的终端

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed Claude to post its private sign-in notice at every @mention from someone who hasn't connected their Claude account, instead of going quiet after the first
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] Claude 每次被尚未连接 Claude 账户的人 @ 时，都会发送一条仅本人可见的登录提示，而不是第一次之后就不再提示

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved "Notify members now" in admin settings: one press reaches every workspace your organization claimed in an Enterprise Grid, and more members in large workspaces
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进管理设置中的「Notify members now」：一次点击即可覆盖组织在 Enterprise Grid 中认领的所有工作区，并覆盖大型工作区中更多的成员

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude's wait notice on self-hosted environments with on-demand runners: it now says whether a runner is starting, a start will be retried, or no runner will start
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进按需运行器的自托管环境中 Claude 的等待提示：现在会说明运行器是否正在启动、启动是否会重试，或是否不会启动任何运行器

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved the error shown when adding a channel manager fails because the channel's Slack workspace can't be confirmed as connected to your organization
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进添加频道管理员失败时的错误提示：当无法确认该频道所在的 Slack 工作区已连接到你的组织时，会给出说明

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved a channel's access lists in admin settings to show the connectors, repositories and plugins an auto-join pattern attaches, and where each comes from
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进管理设置中的频道访问列表：会显示自动加入规则附加的连接器、仓库和插件，以及每项的来源

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved adding repositories as a channel manager: when your GitHub sign-in can't confirm you're a repository admin, the page asks you to sign in with GitHub
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进频道管理员添加仓库的流程：如果你的 GitHub 登录无法确认你是仓库管理员，页面会要求你用 GitHub 登录

entries.en: Fixed a damaged response stream showing raw errors such as "JSON Parse error" or "undefined is not an object", or writing the word "undefined" into an answer, instead of being retried or reported as an interrupted response
entries.zh: 修复了显示原始错误（例如“JSON 解析错误”或“未定义不是对象”）的损坏响应流，或将“未定义”一词写入答案，而不是重试或报告为中断响应

entries.en: Fixed an overloaded or server error arriving right after a thinking block ending the turn with an error instead of being retried
entries.zh: 修复了思维块以错误结束回合而不是重试后立即出现的过载或服务器错误

entries.en: Fixed "Prompt is too long" errors that persisted after compacting: when the compacted request is still too long, Claude Code now compacts once more, keeping less of the recent conversation
entries.zh: 修复了压缩后仍然存在的“提示太长”错误：当压缩的请求仍然太长时，克劳德代码现在会再次压缩，保留较少的最近对话

entries.en: Fixed a session whose model is unavailable, with no fallback model left, showing a bare "is currently unavailable" message (or "Something went wrong" in cloud sessions) instead of the model-unavailable notice and its Learn more link
entries.zh: 修复了模型不可用的会话，没有留下后备模型，仅显示“当前不可用”消息（或云会话中的“出现问题”），而不是模型不可用通知及其“了解更多”链接

entries.en: Fixed Agent SDK sessions crashing when a user message contains an image with a malformed `source`, and failing on every later turn after a malformed document block; a malformed image is now replaced with an explanatory note
entries.zh: 修复了当用户消息包含带有格式错误的“源”的图像时代理 SDK 会话崩溃，以及在格式错误的文档块之后的每个回合中失败的问题；格式错误的图像现已替换为解释性注释

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool calls in a resumed session failing with "No such tool available" while their server was still connecting; the call now waits up to 10 seconds for the server
entries.zh: 修复了恢复会话中的 MCP 工具调用在服务器仍在连接时失败并显示“没有此类工具可用”的问题；呼叫现在等待服务器长达 10 秒

entries.en: Fixed repeated calls to the plan-usage endpoint after it rate-limits or rejects your login: `/usage`, `/extra-usage` and IDE usage views now back off instead of re-asking
entries.zh: 修复了在限制速率或拒绝登录后重复调用计划使用端点的问题：`/usage`、`/extra-usage`和 IDE 使用视图现在会后退而不是重新询问

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp add` reporting success when managed settings restrict MCP servers to plugins; it now refuses and says what to do, instead of saving a server that never loads
entries.zh: 修复了当托管设置将 MCP 服务器限制为插件时`claude mcp add`报告成功的问题；它现在拒绝并说明要做什么，而不是保存永远不会加载的服务器

entries.en: Fixed the `/plugin` configure screen: boolean options are now a true/false choice instead of free text, number options refuse invalid input, and ←/→ change an options field instead of switching tabs
entries.zh: 修复 `/plugin` 配置界面：布尔选项现在是"true/false"二选一而非自由输入，数字选项会拒绝无效输入，←/→ 现在用于切换选项字段而非切换标签页

entries.en: Fixed `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE` being interpolated into the Foundry endpoint host unvalidated; a value that is not a plain resource name is now refused
entries.zh: 修复了插入到未验证的 Foundry 端点主机中的`ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE`；现在拒绝非普通资源名称的值

entries.en: Fixed Claude Desktop behind a Claude apps gateway offering no 1M context option: the gateway now marks each 1M-capable model for Desktop automatically
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 应用程序网关后面的 Claude Desktop 不提供 1M 上下文选项的问题：网关现在自动标记每个支持 1M 的桌面模型

entries.en: Fixed ↓ in shell mode selecting a hidden background-tasks pill, which stopped Backspace and Ctrl+U from editing the prompt
entries.zh: 修复 shell 模式下按 ↓ 会选中隐藏的后台任务标签，导致 Backspace 和 Ctrl+U 无法编辑提示框的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool failing on Windows with many plugins enabled: plugin `bin/` directories that don't exist are no longer added to PATH, and inherited entries aren't added twice
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具在启用了许多插件的 Windows 上失败的问题：不存在的插件 `bin/` 目录不再添加到 PATH，并且继承的条目不会添加两次

entries.en: Fixed `sparsePaths` plugin marketplaces cloning empty and replacing a working local copy on older git (before 2.39), which failed every refresh with "marketplace.json file is no longer present"
entries.zh: 修复了 `sparsePaths` 插件市场克隆空并替换较旧 git（2.39 之前）上的工作本地副本的问题，该问题导致每次刷新都会失败，并显示“marketplace.json 文件不再存在”

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen rendering erasing the terminal output above the session when `[` in transcript mode writes the conversation to scrollback (macOS and Linux)
entries.zh: 修复了当转录模式下的`[`将对话写入回滚时，全屏渲染会擦除会话上方的终端输出（macOS 和 Linux）

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen scroll position jumping to the previous message or to the bottom when a reply finished streaming while scrolled up
entries.zh: 修复了当向上滚动回复完成流式传输时，全屏滚动位置跳转到上一条消息或底部的问题

entries.en: Fixed tab bars in dialogs such as `/config` and `/plugin` breaking the title and tab labels mid-word in a narrow terminal; a tab that doesn't fit now moves to the next line whole
entries.zh: 修复了`/config`和`/plugin`等对话框中的选项卡栏，在狭窄的终端中破坏了标题和选项卡标签的中字；不适合的选项卡现在会整个移动到下一行

entries.en: Fixed the `/model` picker showing "+1 model" below the list after scrolling to the last model; the count now covers only the models below the visible rows
entries.zh: 修复滚动到最后一个模型后，`/model` 选择器列表下方仍显示"+1 model"的问题；计数现在只统计可见行下方的模型

entries.en: Fixed `/keybindings` writing Backspace and Delete bindings for a footer action that does nothing into the generated `keybindings.json`
entries.zh: 修复了为页脚操作写入退格键和删除绑定的`/keybindings`，该操作对生成的`keybindings.json`没有任何作用

entries.en: Fixed a rebound agent panel close key (`footer:close`) typing "x" instead of itself on the row of the agent you're viewing
entries.zh: 修复了反弹代理面板关闭键（`footer:close`）在您正在查看的代理行上键入“x”而不是其本身

entries.en: Fixed vim mode `.` not repeating text typed very fast (for example over ssh or in tmux) or pasted without bracketed paste, and leaving the prompt in INSERT mode after repeating a change with nothing typed (such as `cw` then Esc)
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下 `.` 无法重复快速输入（例如通过 ssh 或在 tmux 中）或未用括号粘贴方式粘贴的文字，并且在重复一个没有输入任何内容的修改（如 `cw` 然后按 Esc）后，提示框停留在 INSERT 模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode leaving the cursor on an image placeholder's opening bracket after `dd` on the last line or `yy` at the end of the prompt, where `r` or `x` would break or delete the image
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下，在最后一行执行 `dd` 或在提示框末尾执行 `yy` 后，光标停在图片占位符的开括号上，导致 `r` 或 `x` 会破坏或删除该图片的问题

entries.en: Fixed a key pressed the instant the terminal regained focus answering the Remote Control enable prompt before its short safety delay restarted
entries.zh: 修复了在终端重新获得焦点并在短暂的安全延迟重新启动之前回答远程控制启用提示时按下的按键

entries.en: Fixed the workspace trust dialog appearing a second time after switching renderers or updating when Claude Code was started in the home directory
entries.zh: 修复在主目录中启动 Claude Code 后切换渲染器或更新，工作区信任对话框会再次出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed rules symlinked into `.claude/rules` from outside the project being skipped without ever showing the external-imports approval prompt; a `.claude` directory symlinked from outside the project now asks for the same approval
entries.zh: 修复了从项目外部符号链接到`.claude/rules`的规则被跳过，而不会显示外部导入批准提示；从项目外部符号链接的`.claude`目录现在要求相同的批准

entries.en: Fixed plugins from marketplaces, claude.ai and npm pre-approving their own tools via `allowed-tools` under managed `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`; only plugins from an official Anthropic source or a source that managed settings vouch for keep that pre-approval
entries.zh: 修复了来自市场、claude.ai 和 npm 的插件通过托管`allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`下的`allowed-tools`预先批准自己的工具；仅来自官方 Anthropic 来源或管理设置的来源保证保持预先批准的插件

entries.en: Fixed a failed first `claude plugin install` leaving the plugin enabled and recorded when a dependency's version range could not be met
entries.zh: 修复了第一个失败的“claude 插件安装”，当无法满足依赖项的版本范围时，启用并记录插件

entries.en: Fixed the debug log dropping a failed hook's stderr when the hook also wrote to stdout, and logging nothing for a failed hook with no output; failed hooks now also log their status code
entries.zh: 修复调试日志在钩子同时写入 stdout 时丢失失败钩子的 stderr，以及失败且无输出的钩子完全不记录的问题；现在失败的钩子也会记录其状态码

entries.en: Fixed `{"decision":"block"}` returned by Elicitation and ElicitationResult hooks being ignored; it now declines the MCP elicitation, as exit code 2 does
entries.zh: 修复了 Eliitation 和 EliitationResult 钩子返回的 `{"decision":"block"}` 被忽略的问题；它现在拒绝 MCP 引发，如退出代码 2 所做的那样

entries.en: Fixed sessions launched without the `SendMessage` tool (such as by Claude Desktop) still being told to message other sessions with it
entries.zh: 修复了在没有`SendMessage`工具（例如 Claude Desktop）的情况下启动的会话仍被告知用它向其他会话发送消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed a photo sent from the Claude app over Remote Control being lost when its queued message was pulled back into the terminal prompt to edit, and the cursor moving one character for a photo with no caption
entries.zh: 修复了通过远程控制从克劳德应用程序发送的一张照片，当其排队消息被拉回终端提示进行编辑时丢失，并且光标为没有标题的照片移动一个字符

entries.en: Fixed typing a message during an automatic usage-limit wait taking the wait out of the "Continue automatically at usage limit" setting's control when that turn hit the limit again
entries.zh: 修复自动用量上限等待期间输入消息，且该回合再次触碰上限时，等待不再受"在用量上限时自动继续"设置控制的问题

entries.en: Fixed usage-limit warnings suggesting `/upgrade` to users already on the highest Max plan; the warnings and `/upgrade` itself now point at `/usage-credits` when it is available
entries.zh: 修复已是最高 Max 套餐的用户仍收到建议使用 `/upgrade` 的用量上限警告的问题；警告和 `/upgrade` 本身在可用时现在会指向 `/usage-credits`

entries.en: Fixed the Explore subagent switching to Opus on the Claude API when the session runs a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize, such as a custom model behind a proxy; Explore now inherits that model
entries.zh: 修复会话使用 Claude Code 无法识别的模型 ID（如代理后的自定义模型）时，Explore 子智能体在 Claude API 上切换到 Opus 的问题；现在 Explore 会继承该模型

entries.en: Fixed `/loop` status updates in self-paced mode often not being shown because Claude wrote them only in its reasoning; Claude now writes each update, and the outcome when the loop stops, as visible text
entries.zh: 修复了自定进度模式下的`/loop`状态更新经常不会显示的问题，因为克劳德只在推理中编写了它们；克劳德现在将每次更新以及循环停止时的结果写入可见文本

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` failing to upload the working tree when started from a git worktree that the Claude desktop app created on macOS or Linux
entries.zh: 修复了从 Claude 桌面应用程序在 macOS 或 Linux 上创建的 git 工作树启动时`/ultrareview`无法上传工作树的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing to start on Linux when the working directory is write-denied and contains a read-denied directory
entries.zh: 修复了当工作目录被拒绝写入且包含拒绝读取目录时，沙盒 Bash 命令无法在 Linux 上启动的问题

entries.en: Fixed artifact database write results telling Claude that every viewer sees a write to a viewer's private `data/users/` subtree, and added a "view" level to `as_level`
entries.zh: 修复了工件数据库写入结果，告诉 Claude 每个查看者都会看到对查看者私有`data/users/`子树的写入，并向`as_level`添加“查看”级别

entries.en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway answering `431 Request Header Fields Too Large` to every request from a sign-in whose identity provider lists many groups; it now accepts request headers up to 256 KiB
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德应用程序网关对来自身份提供商列出许多组的登录的每个请求应答“431 请求标头字段太大”的问题；它现在接受最大 256 KiB 的请求标头

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Reload Claude from the Memory dialog restarting before an edited file was saved
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在 Memory 对话框中执行 Reload Claude 时，在编辑过的文件保存之前就重启的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a restored tab opening a conversation another Claude process still has open; it now asks first
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复恢复的标签页会打开另一个 Claude 进程仍在使用的对话的问题；现在会先询问

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Focus view sections you expanded closing on their own while a sub-agent is working or when the section's first step is trimmed from view
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复子 agent 工作时，或该区块的第一步被移出视野时，你展开的 Focus 视图区块自行收起的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed typing `/model` and Enter printing usage text into the chat instead of opening the model selector
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复输入 `/model` 并按 Enter 时，用量文字被打印到聊天中、而不是打开模型选择器的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed `/feedback` on Vertex, Bedrock and Foundry being refused after you pressed Send; the report is now saved on this computer, as the terminal does
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在 Vertex、Bedrock 和 Foundry 上按下发送后，`/feedback` 被拒绝的问题；现在和终端一样，报告会保存在本机

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed sign-in waiting up to a minute for the Python extension after a window reload
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复窗口重新加载后，登录最多要等待一分钟 Python 扩展的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Claude Code tabs that stopped responding after Restart Extensions: they now reopen on their conversation
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复执行 Restart Extensions 后 Claude Code 标签页无响应的问题：现在会重新打开并恢复到原对话

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a message from another agent with no recorded sender showing as raw XML in the chat
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复没有记录发送者的其他 agent 消息在聊天中以原始 XML 显示的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed messages from other agents, sessions or channels disappearing after a reload
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复重新加载后，来自其他 agent、会话或频道的消息消失的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a user's own `/mcp`, `/config` or `/settings` command being shadowed by the extension's dialog
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复你自己的 `/mcp`、`/config` 或 `/settings` 命令被扩展的对话框遮住的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed Escape stopping every background agent when no turn was running
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在没有任何轮次运行时按 Escape 会停止所有后台 agent 的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed plugin install links replacing a marketplace you already have that uses the same name
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复插件安装链接替换了你已有的、同名市场的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Prompt is too long" errors after compaction when a large text file is attached to a message
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复压缩（compaction）后，消息附带大型文本文件时出现 "Prompt is too long" 错误的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed chat links to files with non-ASCII characters, spaces or brackets in their path not opening
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复聊天中指向路径含非 ASCII 字符、空格或方括号的文件的链接无法打开的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed a routine's Edit and Duplicate controls saying the routine was still loading while you were offline; they now tell you you're offline
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复离线时，例程的 Edit 和 Duplicate 控件提示例程仍在加载的问题；现在会提示你当前处于离线状态

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the earlier Claude in Slack app's progress card and link previews omitting the repository and Create PR button when a GitHub Enterprise host name contains an underscore
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 GitHub Enterprise 主机名包含下划线时，较早的 Claude in Slack 应用的进度卡片和链接预览不显示仓库及 Create PR 按钮的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude staying silent in a channel whose environment declines to start it; it now posts one notice asking you to contact an admin, and retries when @-mentioned
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复频道的运行环境拒绝启动时，Claude 在该频道中保持沉默的问题；现在它会发送一条通知，请你联系管理员，并在被 @ 时重试

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review giving up without posting a finished review when an unsubmitted review under its GitHub App was open on the pull request; it now retries the post first
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复 GitHub 应用下有未提交的审查草稿留在拉取请求上时，Code Review 放弃发布已完成审查的问题；现在会先重试发布
